descriptions.d33b_cell_mask_walk_80086660: Walks one 8-cell row of a bit-mask terrain block: stores the cell index at +564, copies the 3x3 row masks +568 to +604 and the edge masks +640 to +656, packs the four corner bytes into the small-data words 0x804addec..0x804addf8, then seven times saves them to 0x804addfc.., writes their low bytes to out[9], out[81], out[90], out[0], shifts every mask right and rebuilds the corner bytes, spawns through 0x80086514 (mode 0) or 0x8008659c when bit 0 of the centre mask is set, advances y by 1.0 and the tag by -4; a last byte write closes the row.
